mapping_rule: Every numbered syllabus topic from 1 to 290 is represented by one ordered lesson. PDF-subtopic wording is preserved in each lesson subtopics array. Sections C and D become exercises and projects; Section E becomes optional specialization pathways; Section F becomes the learning roadmap; Section G becomes quality gates in the review notes.
